# Growth systems: knowledge base

Frameworks for treating growth as a system of compounding loops instead of a linear funnel.

Based on methods published openly by **Brian Balfour**, **Andrew Chen**, **Casey Winters** and **Kevin Kwok**. Independent implementation, no affiliation. The originals are worth reading in full:

- [The four fits framework](https://brianbalfour.com/four-fits-growth-framework), Brian Balfour
- [Why product-market fit isn't enough](https://brianbalfour.com/essays/product-market-fit-isnt-enough), Brian Balfour
- [andrewchen.com](https://andrewchen.com), on growth loops and network effects
- [caseyaccidental.com](https://caseyaccidental.com), on retention and marketplaces
- [kwokchain.com](https://kwokchain.com), on defensibility

## What is here

| File | Content |
|---|---|
| `02-frameworks-extraidos/frameworks-retention-engagement.md` | Retention curves, habit loops, activation, resurrection, engagement depth |
| `02-frameworks-extraidos/frameworks-acquisition.md` | Loops versus funnels, the 4 loop categories, Growth Multiplier, K-Factor, channel S-curves |
| `02-frameworks-extraidos/frameworks-monetization.md` | The 4 components (how, when, what, amount), the four fits, value metric, price sensitivity |
| `02-frameworks-extraidos/frameworks-growth-models-psych-experiments.md` | Growth models, ELMR, Psych!, core desires, hypotheses, MVTs, experiment prioritization |
| `03-knowledge-base-rag/kb-principios-regras.md` | Principles on retention, acquisition, monetization and experimentation |
| `03-knowledge-base-rag/kb-conceitos-definicoes.md` | Concepts and definitions, for semantic search |
| `03-knowledge-base-rag/kb-exemplos-aplicados.md` | Applied examples |
| `04-prompt-templates/` | System prompts for the 6 specialist agents in this base |
